# @trysac/mcp-sqlite-readonly

Read-only MCP server over a SQLite file loaded into memory: query_only pragma, single SELECT statements, bound parameters, row, cell and size caps. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Problem, usage, and API.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Layered defenses.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Coverage and strategy.
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): Objective and scope.
